_comment: LOCK 4 OF 4, second copy. public/_headers covers Cloudflare Pages and
Netlify; this covers Vercel. Both ship, because which host a concept demo
ends up on is decided after the build and a lock that depends on
remembering to add it is not a lock. On hosts that ignore this file it is
an inert 400-byte JSON asset, which is the correct cost.
Matches the six directives in the robots meta tag and in _headers exactly.
If one of the three ever changes, change all three.

headers.value: noindex, nofollow, noarchive, nosnippet, noimageindex, notranslate
